title: Does BatchMatMul is still not supported in TF1.15?

labels.name: TFLiteConverter
labels.description: For issues related to TFLite converter

body:
**System information**
- OS Platform and Distribution (e.g., Linux Ubuntu 16.04):MacOS 10.14
- TensorFlow installed from (source or binary):
- TensorFlow version (or github SHA if from source):TF1.15
